tagline.en: Tencent Hunyuan's interactive world model — drive a scene in real time with camera and action controls from a single image.
tagline.zh: 腾讯混元的交互式世界模型——从单张图片出发,用相机与动作控制实时驱动场景。

en: HY-WorldPlay, from Tencent Hunyuan (HY-World), is an interactive world model. From a starting image and a stream of camera or action inputs, it generates video of the scene as you move through it.

It is designed for streaming, real-time interaction with camera-action control. The system builds on Tencent's HunyuanVideo-1.5 for video generation, alongside supporting components such as a Qwen2.5-VL vision-language model and a FLUX.1 Redux image module.
In WorldFoundry it runs as an image-pose-video task — supply an image and a sequence of poses or actions, and it renders the corresponding interactive world video.
zh: HY-WorldPlay 由腾讯混元(HY-World)开发,是一个交互式世界模型。从一张起始图片和一串相机或动作输入出发,它生成随你移动而变化的场景视频。
它面向流式、实时的交互,支持相机-动作控制。系统以腾讯 HunyuanVideo-1.5 作为视频生成底座,并搭配 Qwen2.5-VL 视觉-语言模型、FLUX.1 Redux 图像模块等支撑组件。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它以图像-位姿-视频任务运行——提供一张图片和一串位姿或动作,它便渲染出对应的交互式世界视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want to interactively play through a world from a single image, steering with camera and action controls to generate streaming, real-time-style video.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从单张图片交互式地穿行一个世界、用相机与动作控制来生成流式、实时风格的视频时,使用它。

notFor.en: It targets a multi-GPU setup and needs the HY-WorldPlay and HunyuanVideo-1.5 assets, so it is not a lightweight single-card option.
notFor.zh: 它面向多卡配置,需要 HY-WorldPlay 与 HunyuanVideo-1.5 相关资源,并非轻量的单卡方案。

en: Interactive world model with camera and action control

Built on Tencent's HunyuanVideo-1.5 video stack
